description:
That's to empower individuals on the self-sovereign path.

browser.ssi is a powerful API (in Chrome, it would be named chrome.ssi), bridging tasks related to credentials, such as signing/decrypting, between the internal module and user land. It also provides the state of settings while prioritizing privacy and security, allowing users to choose whether to make them open.

types.description: A credential object picked selectively from `nsICredentialInfo` and `nsICredentialMetaInfo` in the SSI store service.
Criteria to search credentials. If you want a full search, explicitly set primary to false.
Option parameters to build Auth dialog

caption.description: A text description of the authentication. Base title is generated by the system, so add additional information as needed.

submission.description: Reference data for considering auth. Evidence of signed messages, etc. are generated by the system, so add additional information as needed.

enforce.description: Set to true if you want to perform auth dialog even if trusted site or password authorization is valid.

functions.name: searchCredentials
functions.description: Return the requested credentials without secrets such like secret key and private setting. During the execution process, an internal authorization check is performed similar to `browser.ssi.askConsent`.

returns.description: A Promise that will be fulfilled with `array` of `ssi.Credential`. Returns Promise\<[]\> if error.

functions.name: askConsent
functions.description: Ask the user whether to give a permission to the requsting web app

returns.description: A Promise that will be fulfilled with a `boolean` value to indicate the authorization result.

functions.name: askConsentChild
functions.description: Ask the user whether to give a permission to the requsting web app

returns.description: A Promise that will be fulfilled with a `boolean` value to indicate the authorization result. Returns Promise\<false\> if error.
